*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
* Program initialization
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
INITIALIZATION.
  PERFORM APP_INIT.

AT SELECTION-SCREEN ON VALUE-REQUEST FOR PCPATH.
  PERFORM WS_FILENAME_GET CHANGING PCPATH.

AT SELECTION-SCREEN.
  PERFORM VALIDATE_DT_DATES.
  PERFORM CMD USING SSCRFIELDS-UCOMM.

*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
* Start of program...
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
START-OF-SELECTION.
  PERFORM APP_START.

*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
* Subroutine and macro definitions...
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Form  APP_INIT
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM APP_INIT.
  DATA: WORKLOAD_DIR LIKE SAPWLDIR OCCURS 1 WITH HEADER LINE,
  NUM_LINES LIKE SYST-INDEX.

*Set lables on selection screen...
  BUTTON_1 = 'Run in Background'.
  BUTTON_2 = 'Background Jobs'.
  BUTTON_3 = 'Download Extract'.
  TXT001 = 'RBEPlus SCAN2 RIA Extract Specification'.
  TXT002 = 'Client:'.
  TXT003 = 'Table query time frame: 20090501 to 20090630'.
  TXT007 = 'User-Mapping:'.

  TXT010 = 'Extract File Specification:'.
  TXT011 = 'Write extract file to / Download extract file to PC from:'.
  TXT012 = 'Path on local PC'.
  TXT013 = 'Application server:'.

*Default path for file on application server according to operating sys
  IF SYST-OPSYS = 'WN'         OR SYST-OPSYS = 'WN32' OR
  SYST-OPSYS = 'Windows NT' OR SYST-OPSYS = 'PM'.
    APPPATH = 'c:\temp\1B_RBE_S2RIA_P1.txt'.
  ELSE.
    APPPATH = '/tmp/1B_RBE_S2RIA_P1.txt'.
  ENDIF.
*Mandant
  MOVE '100' TO MANDT1.
*Date ..
  MOVE '20090501' TO DT_FROM.
  MOVE '20090630' TO DT_TO.

ENDFORM.                               " APP_INIT

*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Form  cmd
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM CMD USING VALUE(COMMAND) LIKE SSCRFIELDS-UCOMM.
  CASE COMMAND.
    WHEN: 'RBGJ'. PERFORM CMD_BACKGROUND_JOB.
    WHEN: 'DBGJ'. PERFORM CMD_TRANSACTION_SM37.
   WHEN: 'DOWN'. PERFORM DOWNLOAD_EXTRACT USING APPPATH PCPATH.
  ENDCASE.
ENDFORM.                               " CMD

*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Form  APP_START
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM APP_START.
  CALL FUNCTION 'DB_COMMIT'.

*Generate extract file as spool file or file on application server...
    PERFORM OPEN_EXTRACT_FILE USING OUTPUT_MODE.

    PERFORM GENERATE_EXTRACTID.        "generate unique id
    PERFORM EXTRACT_INFO.
    PERFORM SYSTEM_INFO.

    PERFORM CTRL_INFO.
    PERFORM USR_ENCODING.
    PERFORM ENCODING_INFO.
    PERFORM CREATE_MAIN.
    PERFORM USRENCODING_INFO.
    PERFORM CLOSE_EXTRACT_FILE.
ENDFORM.                               " APP_START

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  VALIDATE_DT_DATES
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM VALIDATE_DT_DATES.
* At least the from month should be specified....
  IF DT_FROM IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE I162(00) WITH 'Please specify at least one month in the'
    'table query time frame.'.
    STOP.
  ENDIF.
*  Make sure the 'to' month/year is after the 'from' month/year...
  IF DT_FROM > DT_TO.
  MESSAGE I162(00) WITH
  'Please make sure the '''' from'''' month/year is'
  'before the '''' to'''' month/year. (table query)'.
  STOP.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.                               " VALIDATE_DT_DATES
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  GENERATE_EXTRACTID
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM GENERATE_EXTRACTID.
*generates unique id number in space and time...used as key for extract
  CALL FUNCTION 'SYSTEM_GET_UNIQUE_ID'
       IMPORTING
            UNIQUE_ID = EXTRACTID
       EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS    = 1.
  IF SYST-SUBRC <> 0.
    STOP.                              "no key --> no extract
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.                               " GENERATE_EXTRACTID
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  EXTRACT_INFO
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM EXTRACT_INFO.
  DATA: L_STR(2048) TYPE C,
  L_EXTRACT_TYPE(1) TYPE C,
  L_PREEXTRACT_ID(32) TYPE C.
*write info specific to the exract being created...
  PERFORM TAGINFO USING '~EXTRACTINFO_S2RIA' 'WRITE'.
  L_EXTRACT_TYPE = '0'.
  STRUCTUREID = ''.
  L_PREEXTRACT_ID = '4A51DB5CC0E60077E1008000A1A2F41A'.
  CONDENSE EXTRACTID NO-GAPS.
  CONCATENATE EXTRACTID SYST-DATUM SYST-HOST SYST-UNAME L_EXTRACT_TYPE
  EXTRACT_OPTION '000000' '000000' DT_FROM DT_TO
  STRUCTUREID L_PREEXTRACT_ID
  INTO L_STR SEPARATED BY '|'.
  PERFORM WRITE_CONTENT USING L_STR.
ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  SYSTEM_INFO
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM SYSTEM_INFO.
  DATA: L_STR(150)   TYPE C,
    L_CUSTKEY          LIKE LICENSE-SYSTEMID,
    L_INSTNUMBER       LIKE LICENSE-INSTNUMBER,
  L_LICINFO(50) TYPE C.
* write info specific to the system program is being run on...
  PERFORM TAGINFO USING '~SYSTEMINFO' 'WRITE'.
* get installation/license number...
  L_LICINFO = ''.
  CALL FUNCTION 'SLIC_GET_SYSTEM_ID'
    IMPORTING
      SYSTEMID = L_CUSTKEY.
  CALL FUNCTION 'SLIC_GET_LICENCE_NUMBER'
    IMPORTING
      license_number = L_INSTNUMBER.
  CONCATENATE L_CUSTKEY L_INSTNUMBER INTO L_LICINFO SEPARATED BY '~'.
  CONCATENATE L_LICINFO SYST-SAPRL SYST-SYSID MANDT1
    SY-OPSYS SY-DBSYS ABAPVERS INTO L_STR SEPARATED BY '|'.
  PERFORM WRITE_CONTENT USING L_STR.
ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  CTRL_INFO
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM CTRL_INFO.
  DATA: L_CONV(25)  TYPE C,
        L_CSIZE(1)  TYPE C,
        L_STR(100)  TYPE C.
* write info specific to the system program is being run on...
  PERFORM TAGINFO USING '~CTRLINFO' 'WRITE'.
* get language/unicode/delemiter-info
  MOVE CL_ABAP_CHAR_UTILITIES=>CHARSIZE TO L_CSIZE.
  CONCATENATE 'DELIMIT' CONDEL INTO L_CONV.
  CONCATENATE SY-LANGU  L_CSIZE L_CONV
  INTO L_STR SEPARATED BY '|'.
  PERFORM WRITE_CONTENT USING L_STR.
ENDFORM.
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       FORM USR_ENCODING
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
DEFINE _addUsrEncSAP.
  READ TABLE IT_USR WITH KEY BNAME = &1 BINARY SEARCH.
  IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
    CONCATENATE IT_USR-USTYP '-' IT_USR-BNAME INTO IT_USR-ENAME.
    CONDENSE IT_USR-ENAME NO-GAPS. MODIFY TABLE IT_USR.
  ELSE.
    CLEAR IT_USR. IT_USR-BNAME = &1. IT_USR-USTYP = '-'.
    CONCATENATE IT_USR-USTYP '>' &1 INTO IT_USR-ENAME.
    APPEND IT_USR.
  ENDIF.
END-OF-DEFINITION.
*-------------------------------
FORM USR_ENCODING.
  PERFORM TAGINFO USING '~USRENCODING' 'BUILD'.
* get the user names and account groups...
  DATA: LCNT TYPE I VALUE 1000.
  SELECT BNAME BNAME USTYP CLASS BCODE MANDT INTO IT_USR FROM USR02
   CLIENT SPECIFIED ORDER BY BCODE.
    IF IT_USR-USTYP EQ 'A'.
      LCNT = LCNT + 1. MOVE LCNT TO IT_USR-ENAME. CONDENSE IT_USR-ENAME.
      CONCATENATE IT_USR-USTYP '_X' IT_USR-ENAME 'X' INTO IT_USR-ENAME.
    ELSE.
      CONCATENATE IT_USR-USTYP '-' IT_USR-ENAME INTO IT_USR-ENAME.
    ENDIF.
    CONDENSE IT_USR-ENAME NO-GAPS. CLEAR IT_USR-BCODE.
    IF IT_USR-MANDT NE MANDT1. CLEAR IT_USR-MANDT. ENDIF. APPEND IT_USR.
  ENDSELECT. COMMIT WORK.
  SORT IT_USR BY BNAME ASCENDING MANDT DESCENDING.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM IT_USR COMPARING BNAME. CLEAR IT_USR.

  SELECT DISTINCT USR22~BNAME USR02~BNAME INTO IT_USR FROM USR22
   LEFT JOIN USR02 ON USR22~BNAME = USR02~BNAME CLIENT SPECIFIED
   WHERE USR22~BNAME NE ''.
    IF IT_USR-ENAME IS INITIAL.
      LCNT = LCNT + 1. MOVE LCNT TO IT_USR-ENAME. IT_USR-USTYP = 'X'.
      CONDENSE IT_USR-ENAME.
      CONCATENATE IT_USR-USTYP '_X' IT_USR-ENAME 'X' INTO IT_USR-ENAME.
      CONDENSE IT_USR-ENAME NO-GAPS. APPEND IT_USR.
    ENDIF.
  ENDSELECT. COMMIT WORK. CLEAR IT_USR.
  SORT IT_USR BY BNAME.
  _addUsrEncSAP 'SAP'. _addUsrEncSAP 'SAP*'.
  _addUsrEncSAP 'SAPSYS'. _addUsrEncSAP 'DDIC'.
  CLEAR IT_USR. SORT IT_USR BY BNAME.
 ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  USRENCODING_INFO
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM USRENCODING_INFO.
  DATA L_STR(50)  TYPE C.
* write info specific to the encoding of users...
  PERFORM TAGINFO USING '~USRENCODING' 'WRITE'.
  LOOP AT IT_USR.
    IF ENCINFO NE 'X'. IT_USR-BNAME = IT_USR-ENAME. ENDIF.
    CONCATENATE IT_USR-BNAME IT_USR-ENAME IT_USR-MANDT IT_USR-CLASS
    INTO L_STR SEPARATED BY '|'.
    PERFORM WRITE_CONTENT USING L_STR.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM.
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       FORM TF_CONVTSTAMP
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM TF_CONVTSTAMP USING LDATE CHANGING LTSTAMP.
  CALL FUNCTION 'RKE_TIMESTAMP_CONVERT_INPUT'
       EXPORTING
            I_DATE        = LDATE
            I_DAYST       = SY-DAYST
            I_TIME        = '000000'
            I_TZONE       = SY-TZONE
       IMPORTING
            E_TIMESTMP    = LTSTAMP
       EXCEPTIONS
            DATE_INVALID  = 1
            OTHERS        = 2.
  IF SY-SUBRC NE 0.
    LTSTAMP = 0.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.                               "TF_CONVTSTAMP
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  TAGINFO
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM TAGINFO USING P_TAGTYPE LIKE TAGTYPE P_FUNC LIKE TAGFUNC.
  DATA: TS_STR(14)   TYPE C,
        P_TAGSTR(100) TYPE C.
  CLEAR: TS_STR, P_TAGSTR.
  GET TIME.
  TS_STR(8) = SY-DATUM.
  TS_STR+8(6) = SY-UZEIT.
  CONCATENATE P_TAGTYPE P_FUNC TS_STR INTO P_TAGSTR SEPARATED BY ' '.
  PERFORM WRITE_CONTENT USING P_TAGSTR.
ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  TAGROWS
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM TAGROWS USING P_TAGTYPE LIKE TAGTYPE P_FUNC LIKE TAGFUNC.
  DATA: DB_STR(14) TYPE C,
        P_TAGSTR(100) TYPE C.
  CLEAR: DB_STR, P_TAGSTR.
  DB_STR = SY-DBCNT.
  CONDENSE DB_STR.
  CONCATENATE P_TAGTYPE P_FUNC DB_STR INTO P_TAGSTR SEPARATED BY ' '.
  PERFORM WRITE_CONTENT USING P_TAGSTR.
ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  OPEN_EXTRACT_FILE
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM OPEN_EXTRACT_FILE USING P_MODE.
  DATA: LEN TYPE I.
*open a new file on the application server for output...
  IF P_MODE = 'O'.
    OPEN DATASET APPPATH FOR OUTPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
    IF SYST-SUBRC NE 0.
      LEN = STRLEN( APPPATH ).
      WRITE: / 'There was an error opening the file in output mode:',
      AT /1(LEN) APPPATH COLOR 6.
      SKIP 2.
      WRITE: / 'Please check that the directory exists on the',
      'application server:', SYST-HOST.
      STOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.
*open a file on the application server for appending more data...
  IF P_MODE = 'A'.
    OPEN DATASET APPPATH FOR APPENDING IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
    IF SYST-SUBRC NE 0.
      LEN = STRLEN( APPPATH ).
      WRITE: / 'There was an error opening the file in append mode:',
      AT /1(LEN) APPPATH COLOR 6.
      SKIP 2.
      WRITE: / 'Please check that the file and directory exists',
      'on the application server:', SYST-HOST.
      STOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.                               " OPEN_EXTRACT_FILE

*&      Form  CLOSE_EXTRACT_FILE
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM CLOSE_EXTRACT_FILE.
*close file on application server...
  CLOSE DATASET APPPATH.
ENDFORM.                               " CLOSE_EXTRACT_FILE

*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Form  CMD_BACKGROUND_JOB
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM CMD_BACKGROUND_JOB.
  DATA: JOB_NAME         LIKE TBTCO-JOBNAME,
  JOB_NR           LIKE TBTCO-JOBCOUNT,
  JOB_RELEASED     TYPE C,
  JOB_START_SOFORT TYPE C.
  DATA: TITEL(15) TYPE C,
  TEXT1(35) TYPE C,
  TEXT2(40) TYPE C,
  ANSWER    TYPE C.
  DATA: PARAMS    LIKE PRI_PARAMS,
  VALID     TYPE C.
*make sure user has selected where to create the extract file --
*either the spool or application server
  IF APPPATH EQ SPACE.
    MESSAGE I162(00) WITH
    'Please choose where to write the extract file.'.
    STOP.
  ENDIF.
  TEXT1 = 'Job start time'.
  TEXT2 = 'Should the job start immediatly'.
  CALL FUNCTION 'POPUP_TO_CONFIRM_STEP'
       EXPORTING
            DEFAULTOPTION = 'Y'
            TEXTLINE1     = TEXT2
            TEXTLINE2     = ' '
            TITEL         = TITEL
            START_COLUMN  = 25
            START_ROW     = 6
       IMPORTING
            ANSWER        = ANSWER
       EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS        = 1.
  CASE ANSWER.
    WHEN  'J'.   JOB_START_SOFORT = 'X'. " YES
    WHEN  'N'.   JOB_START_SOFORT = ' '.                    " No
    WHEN  'A'.   EXIT.                 " Abbrechen
    WHEN OTHERS. EXIT.
  ENDCASE.
*background job name will be the name of the report program...
  JOB_NAME = SYST-REPID.
*open the background job and get a job number
  CALL FUNCTION 'JOB_OPEN'
       EXPORTING
            JOBNAME          = JOB_NAME
       IMPORTING
            JOBCOUNT         = JOB_NR
       EXCEPTIONS
            CANT_CREATE_JOB  = 1
            INVALID_JOB_DATA = 2
            JOBNAME_MISSING  = 3
            OTHERS           = 4.
  IF SYST-SUBRC NE 0.
    MESSAGE I162(00) WITH
    'An error occured while creating the background job.'.
    STOP.
  ELSE.
*set print parameters to output any errors to spool...
    CALL FUNCTION 'GET_PRINT_PARAMETERS'
         EXPORTING
              IMMEDIATELY            = ' '
              MODE                   = 'BATCH'
              NO_DIALOG              = 'X'
              RELEASE                = 'X'
              NEW_LIST_ID            = 'X'
              LINE_SIZE              = SY-LINSZ
              LIST_NAME              = 'RBE'
              LIST_TEXT              = 'RBE Extract Results'
         IMPORTING
              OUT_PARAMETERS         = PARAMS
              VALID                  = VALID
         EXCEPTIONS
              ARCHIVE_INFO_NOT_FOUND = 1
              INVALID_PRINT_PARAMS   = 2
              INVALID_ARCHIVE_PARAMS = 3
              OTHERS                 = 4.
    IF VALID NE SPACE.
*submit job with all the selection screen params...
      SUBMIT (JOB_NAME) USER SYST-UNAME
      VIA JOB JOB_NAME NUMBER JOB_NR
      WITH MANDT1 = MANDT1
      WITH DT_FROM  = DT_FROM
      WITH DT_TO    = DT_TO
      WITH ENCINFO  = ENCINFO

      WITH APPPATH = APPPATH
      WITH PCPATH   = PCPATH
      TO SAP-SPOOL SPOOL PARAMETERS PARAMS
      WITHOUT SPOOL DYNPRO
      AND RETURN.
      IF SYST-SUBRC <> 0.
        CASE SYST-SUBRC.
          WHEN  4.
            MESSAGE I162(00) WITH
            'Error defining background job!'
            ' Background job canceled by User.'.
          WHEN 8.
            MESSAGE I162(00) WITH
            'Error defining background job!'
            ' Error in job scheduling (JOB_SUBMIT)'.
          WHEN 12.
            MESSAGE I162(00) WITH
            'Error defining background job!'
            ' Error in internal number assignment'.
        ENDCASE.

      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
*close the job...
    CALL FUNCTION 'JOB_CLOSE'
         EXPORTING
              JOBCOUNT             = JOB_NR
              JOBNAME              = JOB_NAME
              STRTIMMED            = JOB_START_SOFORT
         IMPORTING
              JOB_WAS_RELEASED     = JOB_RELEASED
         EXCEPTIONS
              CANT_START_IMMEDIATE = 1
              INVALID_STARTDATE    = 2
              JOBNAME_MISSING      = 3
              JOB_CLOSE_FAILED     = 4
              JOB_NOSTEPS          = 5
              JOB_NOTEX            = 6
              LOCK_FAILED          = 7
              OTHERS               = 8.
    IF SYST-SUBRC <> 0.
      MESSAGE I162(00) WITH
      'An error occured while closing the background job.'.
      STOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.                               " START_AS_BACKGROUND_JOB
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Form  CMD_TRANSACTION_SM37
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM CMD_TRANSACTION_SM37.
  DATA: PARAMS LIKE BDCDATA OCCURS 1 WITH HEADER LINE.
  IF SYST-SAPRL(1) = '3'.              " Release 3XX
*start batch definition to see background jobs via transaction SM37
    PARAMS-PROGRAM  = 'SAPLBTCH'.
    PARAMS-DYNPRO   = 1170.
    PARAMS-DYNBEGIN = 'X'.
    APPEND PARAMS. CLEAR PARAMS.
*name of the job...
    PARAMS-FNAM     = 'BTCH1170-JOBNAME'.
    IF SYST-REPID(1) <> '!'.
      PARAMS-FVAL  = SYST-REPID.
    ELSE.
      PARAMS-FVAL  = '*'.
    ENDIF.
    APPEND PARAMS. CLEAR PARAMS.
*username..
    PARAMS-FNAM     = 'BTCH1170-USERNAME'.
    PARAMS-FVAL     = SYST-UNAME.
    APPEND PARAMS. CLEAR PARAMS.
*from date...
    PARAMS-FNAM     = 'BTCH1170-FROM_DATE'.
    PARAMS-FVAL     = ''.
    APPEND PARAMS. CLEAR PARAMS.
*show jobs with no dates...
    PARAMS-FNAM     = 'BTCH1170-NO_DATE'.
    PARAMS-FVAL     = 'X'.
    APPEND PARAMS. CLEAR PARAMS.
*set ok-code...
    PARAMS-FNAM     = 'BDC_OKCODE'.
    PARAMS-FVAL     = '/8'.
    APPEND PARAMS. CLEAR PARAMS.
  ELSE.                                " Release 4XX
*start batch definition to see background jobs via transaction SM37
    PARAMS-PROGRAM  = 'SAPLBTCH'.
    PARAMS-DYNPRO   = 2170.
    PARAMS-DYNBEGIN = 'X'.
    APPEND PARAMS. CLEAR PARAMS.
*name of the job...
    PARAMS-FNAM     = 'BTCH2170-JOBNAME'.
    IF SYST-REPID(1) <> '!'.
      PARAMS-FVAL  = SYST-REPID.
    ELSE.
      PARAMS-FVAL  = '*'.
    ENDIF.
    APPEND PARAMS. CLEAR PARAMS.
*username...
    PARAMS-FNAM     = 'BTCH2170-USERNAME'.
    PARAMS-FVAL     = SYST-UNAME.
    APPEND PARAMS. CLEAR PARAMS.
*from date...
    PARAMS-FNAM     = 'BTCH2170-FROM_DATE'.
    PARAMS-FVAL     = ''.
    APPEND PARAMS. CLEAR PARAMS.
*show jobs with no dates...
    PARAMS-FNAM     = 'BTCH2170-PRELIM'.
    PARAMS-FVAL     = 'X'.
    APPEND PARAMS. CLEAR PARAMS.
*set ok-code...
    PARAMS-FNAM     = 'BDC_OKCODE'.
    PARAMS-FVAL     = '/8'.
    APPEND PARAMS. CLEAR PARAMS.
  ENDIF.
*call the transaction using params set above...and show screen only
*if any errors occur...
  CALL TRANSACTION 'SM37' USING PARAMS
  MODE  'E'.
ENDFORM.

*&      Form  DOWNLOAD_EXTRACT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM DOWNLOAD_EXTRACT USING P_APPPATH P_PCPATH.
*make sure path is specified for where to put the extract file...
  IF P_PCPATH IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE I162(00) WITH 'Please enter a path on the PC.'.
    STOP.
  ENDIF.
  IF P_APPPATH IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE I162(00) WITH 'Please enter a path on the app. server.'.
    STOP.
  ENDIF.
  PERFORM FILE_DOWNLOAD USING P_APPPATH P_PCPATH.
ENDFORM.                               " DOWNLOAD_EXTRACT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  FILE_DOWNLOAD
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM FILE_DOWNLOAD USING P_APPPATH P_PCPATH.
  DATA: L_ERRMSG1(50) TYPE C,
  L_ERRMSG2(50) TYPE C.
*make sure the directories exist on the PC and the application server...
  PERFORM CHECK_PC_DIR_EXISTS USING P_PCPATH.
  PERFORM CHECK_APPSERV_DIR_EXISTS USING P_APPPATH.
  LEAVE TO LIST-PROCESSING.
*open file on application server for reading....

  OPEN DATASET P_APPPATH FOR INPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
  IF SYST-SUBRC <> 0.
    L_ERRMSG1 = 'The following file could not be opened on the app.'.
    CONCATENATE 'server' SYST-HOST ':' P_APPPATH
    INTO L_ERRMSG2 SEPARATED BY ' '.
    MESSAGE I162(00) WITH L_ERRMSG1 L_ERRMSG2.
    EXIT.
  ELSE.
*start reading data in file on application server....
    DO.
      READ DATASET P_APPPATH INTO TXT_LINES.
      IF SYST-SUBRC <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
*append data in file to internal table txt_lines...
      APPEND TXT_LINES.
    ENDDO.
    CLOSE DATASET P_APPPATH.
*download internal table txt_lines to selected directory on PC...
    PERFORM WS_DOWNLOAD USING P_PCPATH.
  ENDIF.
  LEAVE LIST-PROCESSING.
ENDFORM.                               " FILE_DOWNLOAD
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  WS_DOWNLOAD
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

  DATA: L_MSG(50) TYPE C.
  DATA: L_FILENAME TYPE STRING.
  DATA: L_FILETYPE TYPE CHAR10.
  L_FILENAME = FILENAME.
  L_FILETYPE = FILETYPE.
*download internal table to PC....

      DATA_TAB                        = TXT_LINES
   EXCEPTIONS
     FILE_WRITE_ERROR                = 1

     INVALID_TYPE                    = 4
     NO_AUTHORITY                    = 5
     UNKNOWN_ERROR                   = 6
     HEADER_NOT_ALLOWED              = 7
     SEPARATOR_NOT_ALLOWED           = 8
     FILESIZE_NOT_ALLOWED            = 9
     HEADER_TOO_LONG                 = 10
     DP_ERROR_CREATE                 = 11
     DP_ERROR_SEND                   = 12
     DP_ERROR_WRITE                  = 13
     UNKNOWN_DP_ERROR                = 14
     ACCESS_DENIED                   = 15
     DP_OUT_OF_MEMORY                = 16
     DISK_FULL                       = 17
     DP_TIMEOUT                      = 18
     FILE_NOT_FOUND                  = 19
     DATAPROVIDER_EXCEPTION          = 20
     CONTROL_FLUSH_ERROR             = 21
     OTHERS                          = 22
            .
  IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.
    MESSAGE ID SY-MSGID TYPE SY-MSGTY NUMBER SY-MSGNO
            WITH SY-MSGV1 SY-MSGV2 SY-MSGV3 SY-MSGV4.
  ELSE.
*let user know file was downloaded without problems...

  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.                               "ws_download
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  check_pc_dir_exists
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM CHECK_PC_DIR_EXISTS USING FILENAME.
  DATA: PATH LIKE PCPATH.
*split file and path....
  CALL FUNCTION 'SO_SPLIT_FILE_AND_PATH'
       EXPORTING
            FULL_NAME = FILENAME
       IMPORTING
            FILE_PATH = PATH
       EXCEPTIONS
            X_ERROR   = 1
            OTHERS    = 2.
*check the directory exists...
  CALL FUNCTION 'WS_QUERY'
  EXPORTING
*         ENVIRONMENT    = ' '
  FILENAME       = PATH
  QUERY          = 'DE'
*         WINID          = ' '
  IMPORTING
  RETURN         = ERR_CODE
  EXCEPTIONS
  INV_QUERY      = 1
  NO_BATCH       = 2
  FRONTEND_ERROR = 3
  OTHERS         = 4.
  IF ERR_CODE EQ '0'.
    MESSAGE I162(00) WITH 'Directory does not exist on the PC:' PATH.
    STOP.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.                               " check_pc_dir_exists
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  CHECK_APPSERV_DIR_EXISTS
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM CHECK_APPSERV_DIR_EXISTS USING FILENAME.
  DATA: lf_fullname LIKE PCPATH,
        lf_filename LIKE PCPATH,
        lf_path     LIKE PCPATH,
        lf_dirlen   TYPE i.
  DATA: ITAB LIKE SALFLDIR OCCURS 1.

  lf_fullname = FILENAME.

* Dateiname suchen
  WHILE lf_fullname CA ':\/'.
    ADD 1 TO sy-fdpos.
    ADD sy-fdpos TO lf_dirlen.
    SHIFT lf_fullname LEFT BY sy-fdpos PLACES.
  ENDWHILE.
  lf_filename = lf_fullname.

* Directory bestimmen
  IF lf_dirlen > 0.
    lf_path = FILENAME(lf_dirlen).
  ENDIF.

* make sure directory exists on the application server...
  CALL FUNCTION 'RZL_READ_DIR'
  EXPORTING
*         FROMLINE       = 0
  NAME           = lf_path
  NRLINES        = 10
*         SRVNAME        = ' '
  TABLES
  FILE_TBL       = ITAB
  EXCEPTIONS
  ARGUMENT_ERROR = 1
  NOT_FOUND      = 2
  SEND_ERROR     = 3
  OTHERS         = 4.
  IF SY-SUBRC NE 0.
    MESSAGE I162(00)
    WITH 'Directory does not exist on the app. server:' lf_path.
    STOP.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.                               " CHECK_APPSERV_DIR_EXISTS

  ENDIF.

*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       FORM REP_CNTDLM
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM REP_CNTDLM.
  perform REP_CNTDLM_NC.
  condense content.
ENDFORM.
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       FORM REP_CNTDLM_NC
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM REP_CNTDLM_NC.
*hex_0d
  replace all occurrences of cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf
    in content with ' '.
*hex_0a
  replace all occurrences of cl_abap_char_utilities=>newline
    in content with ' '.
*delimiter
  replace all occurrences of '|' in content with '¡~¡'.
ENDFORM.
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       MAKROs
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
DEFINE _R4CDLMNC.
*hex_0d
  replace all occurrences of cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf
    in content with ' '.
*hex_0a
  replace all occurrences of cl_abap_char_utilities=>newline
    in content with ' '.
*delimiter
  replace all occurrences of '|' in content with '¡~¡'.
END-OF-DEFINITION.
*-------------------------------
DEFINE _R4CDLM.
  _R4CDLMNC. condense content.
END-OF-DEFINITION.
*-------------------------------
DEFINE _WC2TAB.
 write &1 to content. &2.
 concatenate cnttab-out content into cnttab-out separated by '|'.
END-OF-DEFINITION.
*-------------------------------
DEFINE _MC2TAB.
 move &1 to content. &2.
 concatenate cnttab-out content into cnttab-out separated by '|'.
END-OF-DEFINITION.
*-------------------------------
DEFINE _MWC2TAB.
 _MC2TAB &1 _R4CDLMNC. write &1 to content. &2.
 concatenate cnttab-out content into cnttab-out separated by CONDEL.
END-OF-DEFINITION.
*-------------------------------
DEFINE _EC2TAB.
  IF &1 EQ ''.
    CLEAR IT_USR.
  ELSE.
    READ TABLE IT_USR WITH KEY BNAME = &1 BINARY SEARCH.
    IF SY-SUBRC NE 0.
      CLEAR IT_USR. IT_USR-BNAME = &1. IT_USR-USTYP = '-'.
      MOVE SY-TFILL TO IT_USR-ENAME. CONDENSE IT_USR-ENAME.
      CONCATENATE IT_USR-USTYP '>UNK' IT_USR-ENAME INTO IT_USR-ENAME.
      APPEND IT_USR. SORT IT_USR BY BNAME.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.
 _MC2TAB IT_USR-ENAME _R4CDLM.
END-OF-DEFINITION.
*-------------------------------
DEFINE _D2M2TAB.
  move &1+0(6) to content.
  concatenate cnttab-out content into cnttab-out separated by '|'.
END-OF-DEFINITION.
*-------------------------------
DEFINE _MRGWRITE.
  if cntcur-out ne ''.
    write cntcur-val to content. condense content.
    concatenate cntcur-out content into cntcur-out separated by '|'.
    perform WRITE_CONTENT using cntcur-out.
  endif.
END-OF-DEFINITION.
*-------------------------------
DEFINE _MRGSTEP.
  if ( cnttab-out = cntcur-out ).
    cntcur-val = cntcur-val + cnttab-val.
  else.
    _MRGWRITE. cntcur = cnttab.
  endif.
END-OF-DEFINITION.
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       FORM CREATE_MAIN
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM CREATE_MAIN.
  DATA: DT_GJAHR(4) TYPE N, DT_GVJAHR(4) TYPE N, DT_NOW LIKE SY-DATUM,
        DT_FTM12 LIKE SY-DATUM, DT_TMP TYPE I.
  PERFORM TAGINFO USING '~ADDONDATA' 'WRITE'.
  SET COUNTRY 'DE'.
  IF SY-SUBRC = 4. SET COUNTRY 'D'. ENDIF.
  IF MANDT1 = ''. MANDT1 = SY-MANDT. ENDIF.
  DT_GJAHR = DT_TO. DT_GVJAHR = DT_GJAHR - 1. DT_NOW = SY-DATUM.
  DT_TMP = DT_TO+6(2). DT_TMP = DT_TMP + 1. DT_FTM12+0(4) = DT_GVJAHR.
  DT_FTM12+4(2) = DT_TO+4(2). DT_FTM12+6(2) = DT_TMP.
  DATA: ST_FROM TYPE RKE_TSTMP, ST_TO TYPE RKE_TSTMP,
        ST_FTM12 TYPE RKE_TSTMP.
  PERFORM TF_CONVTSTAMP USING DT_FROM CHANGING ST_FROM.
  PERFORM TF_CONVTSTAMP USING DT_FTM12 CHANGING ST_FTM12.
  PERFORM TF_CONVTSTAMP USING DT_TO CHANGING ST_TO.
  DATA: USRSBCS TYPE RANGE OF USR02-BNAME,
        USRSBCS_LINE LIKE LINE OF USRSBCS.
  SELECT BNAME AS LOW INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE USRSBCS
    FROM USR02 CLIENT SPECIFIED
    WHERE MANDT EQ MANDT1 AND USTYP IN ('B', 'C', 'S').
  USRSBCS_LINE-SIGN = 'I'. USRSBCS_LINE-OPTION = 'EQ'.
  MODIFY USRSBCS FROM USRSBCS_LINE TRANSPORTING SIGN OPTION
    WHERE SIGN = '' AND OPTION = ''.

*----------------------------------------------------------------
PERFORM TAGINFO USING '~~SQLINFOTS' '5C5CC71246CA455C91C9DD037F26952E'.
DATA: BEGIN OF iTSR2283, CREAT_DATE TYPE ADMI_RUN-CREAT_DATE,
  INTERRUPTD TYPE ADMI_RUN-INTERRUPTD, NOTGUILTY TYPE
  ADMI_RUN-NOTGUILTY, OBJECT TYPE ADMI_RUN-OBJECT, STATUS TYPE
  ADMI_RUN-STATUS, XCOUNT TYPE I, END OF iTSR2283.
DATA: iTST2283 LIKE TABLE OF iTSR2283 WITH NON-UNIQUE KEY CREAT_DATE
  INTERRUPTD NOTGUILTY OBJECT STATUS WITH HEADER LINE.
SELECT DISTINCT ADMI_RUN~CREAT_DATE ADMI_RUN~INTERRUPTD
  ADMI_RUN~NOTGUILTY ADMI_RUN~OBJECT ADMI_RUN~STATUS COUNT(*) INTO
  TABLE iTST2283
FROM ADMI_RUN CLIENT SPECIFIED
GROUP BY ADMI_RUN~CREAT_DATE ADMI_RUN~INTERRUPTD ADMI_RUN~NOTGUILTY
  ADMI_RUN~OBJECT ADMI_RUN~STATUS .
COMMIT WORK.
PERFORM TAGROWS USING '~~ROWINFOTS' '5C5CC71246CA455C91C9DD037F26952E'.
*-------------------------------
PERFORM TAGINFO USING '~~SQLINFOES' '8FDB8E64B33D47CFA331BDA3F4C17272'.
DATA: BEGIN OF iESR2984, OBJECT TYPE ADMI_RUN-OBJECT, STATUS TYPE
  ADMI_RUN-STATUS, XCOUNT TYPE I, END OF iESR2984.
DATA: iEST2984 LIKE TABLE OF iESR2984 WITH NON-UNIQUE KEY OBJECT
  STATUS WITH HEADER LINE.
LOOP AT iTST2283.
  iEST2984-OBJECT = iTST2283-OBJECT.
  iEST2984-STATUS = iTST2283-STATUS.
  iEST2984-XCOUNT = iTST2283-XCOUNT.
  COLLECT iEST2984.
ENDLOOP.
LOOP AT iEST2984. CLEAR CNTTAB. _WC2TAB iEST2984-OBJECT _R4CDLM.
 _MWC2TAB iEST2984-STATUS _R4CDLM. _WC2TAB iEST2984-XCOUNT _R4CDLM.
 CONCATENATE '8FDB8E64B33D47CFA331BDA3F4C17272' 'ADMI_RUN' CNTTAB-OUT+1
 INTO CNTTAB-OUT SEPARATED BY '|'. PERFORM WRITE_CONTENT USING
 CNTTAB-OUT.
ENDLOOP.
CLEAR iEST2984. FREE iEST2984.
*-------------------------------
PERFORM TAGINFO USING '~~SQLINFOES' '4A7D51EB4A944AACB4813903DC54F7B8'.
DATA: BEGIN OF iESR3721, OBJECT TYPE ADMI_RUN-OBJECT, STATUS TYPE
  ADMI_RUN-STATUS, XCOUNT TYPE I, END OF iESR3721.
DATA: iEST3721 LIKE TABLE OF iESR3721 WITH NON-UNIQUE KEY OBJECT
  STATUS WITH HEADER LINE.

DATA: BEGIN OF iTSR2499, BKPF_AWTYP TYPE BKPF-AWTYP, BKPF_BLART TYPE
  BKPF-BLART, BKPF_BUKRS TYPE BKPF-BUKRS, BKPF_DBBLG TYPE BKPF-DBBLG,
  BKPF_GLVOR TYPE BKPF-GLVOR, BKPF_TCODE TYPE BKPF-TCODE, BKPF_USNAM
  TYPE BKPF-USNAM, BSIK_BSCHL TYPE BSIK-BSCHL, BSIK_UMSKS TYPE
  BSIK-UMSKS, BSIK_UMSKZ TYPE BSIK-UMSKZ, BSIK_ZUMSK TYPE BSIK-ZUMSK,
  XCOUNT TYPE I, END OF iTSR2499.
DATA: iTST2499 LIKE TABLE OF iTSR2499 WITH NON-UNIQUE KEY BKPF_AWTYP
  BKPF_BLART BKPF_BUKRS BKPF_DBBLG BKPF_GLVOR BKPF_TCODE BKPF_USNAM
  BSIK_BSCHL BSIK_UMSKS BSIK_UMSKZ BSIK_ZUMSK WITH HEADER LINE.
SELECT DISTINCT BKPF~AWTYP BKPF~BLART BKPF~BUKRS BKPF~DBBLG BKPF~GLVOR
  BKPF~TCODE BKPF~USNAM BSIK~BSCHL BSIK~UMSKS BSIK~UMSKZ BSIK~ZUMSK
  COUNT(*) INTO TABLE iTST2499
FROM BKPF INNER JOIN BSIK ON  BKPF~MANDT = BSIK~MANDT AND
  BKPF~BELNR = BSIK~BELNR AND  BKPF~BUKRS = BSIK~BUKRS AND
  BKPF~GJAHR = BSIK~GJAHR CLIENT SPECIFIED
WHERE BKPF~MANDT EQ MANDT1
  AND ( ( BKPF~CPUDT BETWEEN DT_FROM
  AND DT_TO ) )
GROUP BY BKPF~AWTYP BKPF~BLART BKPF~BUKRS BKPF~DBBLG BKPF~GLVOR
  BKPF~TCODE BKPF~USNAM BSIK~BSCHL BSIK~UMSKS BSIK~UMSKZ BSIK~ZUMSK .

       COUNT(*) AS XCOUNT

  SWDSHEADER-AVG_TOTALT, CHANGED_RL TYPE SWDSHEADER-CHANGED_RL,

  SWDSHEADER-MAX_ACTEXT, MAX_TOTALT TYPE SWDSHEADER-MAX_TOTALT,
  MIN_ACTEXT TYPE SWDSHEADER-MIN_ACTEXT, MIN_TOTALT TYPE
  SWDSHEADER-MIN_TOTALT, ORIG_VERS TYPE SWDSHEADER-ORIG_VERS, PRIORITY
  TYPE SWDSHEADER-PRIORITY, STATUS TYPE SWDSHEADER-STATUS, SUSPEND_E
  TYPE SWDSHEADER-SUSPEND_E, SUSPEND_I TYPE SWDSHEADER-SUSPEND_I, TASK
  TYPE SWDSHEADER-TASK, VERSION TYPE SWDSHEADER-VERSION, WFD_ID TYPE
  SWDSHEADER-WFD_ID, XCOUNT TYPE I, END OF iTSR2400.
DATA: iTST2400 LIKE TABLE OF iTSR2400 WITH NON-UNIQUE KEY ACTIV
  ACTIVAT_ON ACTIVAT_RL AVG_ACTEXT AVG_TOTALT CHANGED_RL CREATED_RL
  EXETYP FB_WF_CREA MAX_ACTEXT MAX_TOTALT MIN_ACTEXT MIN_TOTALT
  ORIG_VERS PRIORITY STATUS SUSPEND_E SUSPEND_I TASK VERSION WFD_ID
  WITH HEADER LINE.
SELECT DISTINCT SWDSHEADER~ACTIV SWDSHEADER~ACTIVAT_ON
  SWDSHEADER~ACTIVAT_RL SWDSHEADER~AVG_ACTEXT SWDSHEADER~AVG_TOTALT
  SWDSHEADER~CHANGED_RL SWDSHEADER~CREATED_RL SWDSHEADER~EXETYP
  SWDSHEADER~FB_WF_CREA SWDSHEADER~MAX_ACTEXT SWDSHEADER~MAX_TOTALT
  SWDSHEADER~MIN_ACTEXT SWDSHEADER~MIN_TOTALT SWDSHEADER~ORIG_VERS
  SWDSHEADER~PRIORITY SWDSHEADER~STATUS SWDSHEADER~SUSPEND_E
  SWDSHEADER~SUSPEND_I SWDSHEADER~TASK SWDSHEADER~VERSION
  SWDSHEADER~WFD_ID COUNT(*) INTO TABLE iTST2400
FROM SWDSHEADER CLIENT SPECIFIED
GROUP BY SWDSHEADER~ACTIV SWDSHEADER~ACTIVAT_ON SWDSHEADER~ACTIVAT_RL
  SWDSHEADER~AVG_ACTEXT SWDSHEADER~AVG_TOTALT SWDSHEADER~CHANGED_RL
  SWDSHEADER~CREATED_RL SWDSHEADER~EXETYP SWDSHEADER~FB_WF_CREA
  SWDSHEADER~MAX_ACTEXT SWDSHEADER~MAX_TOTALT SWDSHEADER~MIN_ACTEXT
  SWDSHEADER~MIN_TOTALT SWDSHEADER~ORIG_VERS SWDSHEADER~PRIORITY
  SWDSHEADER~STATUS SWDSHEADER~SUSPEND_E SWDSHEADER~SUSPEND_I
  SWDSHEADER~TASK SWDSHEADER~VERSION SWDSHEADER~WFD_ID .
COMMIT WORK.
